summary: Silo Pharma filed an 8-K disclosing an October 13, 2026 asset purchase agreement to acquire software and related intellectual property from individual seller Larry King. Consideration is 150,000 newly issued common shares (par $0.0001), sold privately under Section 4(a)(2); no cash price or per-share valuation is stated. Shares carry a lock-up through the earlier of twelve months, a change of control, or company consent, barring hedging, pledges, or transfers. Seller provides customary reps plus indemnities for misrepresentation, third-party infringement, gross negligence, fraud, or intentional misconduct. Watch dilution, valuation implied by SILO's trading price, and resale overhang after lock-up expiry.
